mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_course_progress (user_id, course_id, last_chapter_id, completed_chapters, last_learn_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{chapterId}, #{completedChapters}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_chapter_id = VALUES(last_chapter_id), completed_chapters = VALUES(completed_chapters), last_learn_time = VALUES(last_learn_time), update_time = NOW()
